mapper.select: SELECT ps.spot_id AS spotId, ps.floor, ps.zone, ps.spot_number AS spotNumber, ps.distance_from_entrance AS distanceFromEntrance, ps.is_parked AS isParked, ps.parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, pl.vehicle_num AS vehicleNum FROM parking_spot ps LEFT JOIN parking_log pl ON ps.parking_log_id = pl.parking_log_id ORDER BY ps.floor, ps.zone, ps.spot_number

SELECT ps.spot_id AS spotId, ps.floor, ps.zone, ps.spot_number AS spotNumber, ps.distance_from_entrance AS distanceFromEntrance, ps.is_parked AS isParked, ps.parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, pl.vehicle_num AS vehicleNum FROM parking_spot ps LEFT JOIN parking_log pl ON ps.parking_log_id = pl.parking_log_id WHERE ps.floor = #{floor} ORDER BY ps.zone, ps.spot_number

SELECT spot_id AS spotId, floor, zone, spot_number AS spotNumber, distance_from_entrance AS distanceFromEntrance, is_parked AS isParked, parking_log_id AS parkingLogId FROM parking_spot WHERE spot_id = #{spotId}

SELECT spot_id AS spotId, floor, zone, spot_number AS spotNumber, distance_from_entrance AS distanceFromEntrance, is_parked AS isParked FROM parking_spot WHERE is_parked = false ORDER BY floor, distance_from_entrance LIMIT 1

SELECT spot_id AS spotId, floor, zone, spot_number AS spotNumber, distance_from_entrance AS distanceFromEntrance, is_parked AS isParked, parking_log_id AS parkingLogId FROM parking_spot WHERE is_parked = false ORDER BY floor ASC, distance_from_entrance ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_spot SET is_parked = false, parking_log_id = NULL WHERE spot_id = #{spotId}
UPDATE parking_log SET exit_time = now(), payment_status = true WHERE exit_time IS NULL
UPDATE parking_spot SET is_parked = false, parking_log_id = NULL WHERE is_parked = true
